tldr: MANDATE PARTLY MET: the shared WebSearch budget (200) ran out after 26 successful searches by this agent (mandate: at least 40). WebFetch was EGRESS_BLOCKED on all ~20 hosts tried once each, so no page was read directly and every source is 'per search summary'. No workaround was attempted. Costs, durations, Moadian thresholds, AML thresholds, the Art. 131 table and statute-level items are null or low-confidence/UNVERIFIED with verify_how.

Regulatory map: no crypto statute; CBI is sole licensing/oversight body (policy framework approved 2024-12-03 / 13 Azar 1403; broker directive 58 articles + 28 notes). Unlicensed FX dealing is currency smuggling (fine 2x rial value + confiscation).

Classification: fixed-price Toman digital goods are e-commerce. Card top-ups, a withdrawable wallet, USDT-pay by Iran residents, pay-on-behalf and an exchange-style rate board move the business toward an unlicensed exchange/PSP. Seven tests (T1-T7), a SKU risk-label mapping and design rules D1-D12 are in the doc; lawyer memo is gate G1.

Taxes 1405: VAT 10% (government bill's 12% was rejected; medium confidence, enacted text unseen), company tax 25% flat, individual exemption 480,000,000 IRT/yr with brackets up to 30%. Computed: VAT on the gross price at a fixed market price erodes about 67% of round-0 per-order profit on average. Historical-cost tax drag in a 20% devaluation is about 67% of real profit.

Triggers: more than 100 deposits/month and more than 35M IRT/month makes a personal account 'commercial' (independently corroborated by 03-ir-payments-collection). Moadian e-invoice penalty reported at 10% of sales or 20M rial (low confidence).

Sanctions: OFAC designated Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin, Ramzinex on 2026-06-02, CBI-linked wallets on 2026-04-24 (USD 344.2M frozen) and 2026-07-16 (USD 131M), BitBank on 2026-09-17; Tether froze about USD 550M by 2026-09-29. The STATUS note that the designation was denied/rumour is NOT supported: it is confirmed by many independent sources and the exchanges' own reactions (Treasury primary release not read).

Deliverables: data/tax.json and data/legal_checklist.json (14 ordered steps, 11 go/no-go gates, 10 pause triggers, 15-item ordinal risk register, KYC tiers T0-T3, refund tiers, price-lock and rush defaults) both validate OK; five Persian templates all marked 'needs lawyer review'.

Flag for lead: round-0 plan section 4.3 (use several partners' national IDs to raise exchange deposit caps) resembles splitting to dodge a cap and conflicts with guardrail 3; lawful alternatives are listed in section 8. USDT payment from Iran residents and wallet cash-out should default OFF.
conflicts: VAT 1405: 12% (government bill; Tasnim/Entekhab headlines 'reached 12%') vs 10% (consolidation committee/floor; Tejaratnews, Didbaniran, Eghtesadonline 'finalised', Sepidar, Nabzgheymat). Adjudicated 10%, medium confidence; enacted budget-law text not seen.

OFAC four-exchange designation: STATUS note says denied/rumour-labelled by some Iranian outlets vs Scorechain, TRM, Crystal, Crypto Briefing, Euronews Persian, Mihanblockchain, TRT Farsi and the exchanges' own reactions. Adjudicated as confirmed event (high); Treasury primary release blocked and unread.
Tether frozen totals 344.2M + 131M = 475.2M (reported 2026-09-09) vs about 550M (2026-09-29): cumulative growth, about 75M unexplained increment.
CBI exchange filing deadline: '20 Ordibehesht' vs '1404' in another summary: unresolved, low confidence, not used.
Round-0 plan section 4.3 (multiple partners' national IDs to raise deposit caps) vs CLAUDE.md guardrail 3 (no splitting to dodge caps): flagged non-compliant; lawful alternatives in section 8.
